ticket.subject: Invoice address and slow reports
ticket.body_text:
Hello,

Two things. Our August invoice still shows our old office address; we moved in July and updated it in the billing settings. Our accounts team cannot book the invoice until the address is right, and the books close at the end of next week.

Second, and less important: the Reports page has been a bit slow for me this week, maybe 5 or 6 seconds to load.

Best regards,
Bruno Esposito
project manager, Velloran SAS

label_notes: multi_issue: the invoice address blocks the customer most (billing P3, deadline next week = medium). Second issue: slow Reports page (bug, minor).
